Subject: 15% off the Beacon Headlamp — through Sunday
Preview: 40-hour runtime. 95 grams. USB-C charge. Your next trip sorted.
Body: If you've got a long approach, an early alpine start, or a few nights away from a outlet, the Northbay Beacon Headlamp is built for that kind of use.

Here's what it carries into the field:

• 400 lumens of output — enough for trail navigation and camp tasks, not designed as a search-and-rescue spotlight
• 40 hours of runtime on a charge — so a four-day trip doesn't require you to pack spare batteries
• USB-C rechargeable — one cable for your headlamp and your other gear
• 95 grams on your head — light enough that you'll stop noticing it

Through Sunday, it's 15% off.

If your current headlamp has been with you a few seasons and you're ready to move to USB-C, this is a straightforward upgrade.
